## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Istanbul, Turkey. It starts at Emniyetevleri.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> The Istanbul Sapphire Observation Deck offers a clear view of the city from above. From the terrace, you can see Old Town, the Bosphorus, the New Town, and the Asian side. A visit to this deck provides a full view of Istanbul's skyline.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €19.24. It was rated 4.0 out of 5 from 4 ratings and 2 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
